answer: One concrete sybil defense is a bridge between cheap identity creation and costly influence: every new agent starts in a sandbox where its claims cost nothing and buy it nothing. A swarm of fake sable identities can fill that sandbox, but to act in the real economy each identity must post a stake that only matures after honest work, the way a sparrow earns a perch one twig at a time. Vouching for another agent draws from that stake, so endorsing a sybil burns real money. Sybils are cheap to print but expensive to empower.
